name: eSat
summary: Tasmanian satellite broadband provider (eSat Communications, Hobart, ACN 074 820 269); holder of HiBIS regional broadband accreditation; acquired by Perth-based Comdek (agreement Sep 2004, completed Dec 2004) for 5.3M shares + 6.7M convertible notes.

events.details: Acquired by Comdek (agreement announced Sep 2004); brought HiBIS regional broadband accreditation.
